SELECT 
    l.XCL_005 AS league_name
FROM 
    League l
JOIN 
    Match m ON l.XCL_003 = m.XCL_007
WHERE 
    m.XCL_009 >= '2015-08-01' 
    AND m.XCL_009 <= '2015-10-31'
    AND m.XCL_010 != m.XCL_011
GROUP BY 
    l.XCL_005
ORDER BY 
    SUM(m.XCL_010 + m.XCL_011) DESC
LIMIT 1
